title: Three Years and One Short Signboard
subtitle: 商业公司 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 商业公司（人与社会·商业与经济）
meta: 主题语境：商业公司（人与社会·商业与经济）　|　核心词汇：firm　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 firm 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1958 my grandfather ① set up a firm that no clerk in the street would have named, and he said the setting up was the whole of the spring. The ② firm, meaning the company itself and not the shop, ran three years and stayed unnamed in the book; a firm, he said, is the only thing in a street that is judged by how long it is left unnamed.

Every ③ firm in that street had the same short signboard beside it, and the ④ firm at the far end, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A firm, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to name; my grandfather said the naming is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the firm was the whole of the matter, meaning the resolve and not the company. The ⑥ firm, meaning the resolve and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody names; firm, he said, is either something you set up or the only word that means both a company and a resolve. He said the resolve is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ firm had become a line in a plan, and the plan had become an argument about the short signboard. The ⑧ firm of the whole thing, my grandfather wrote in April, was one street and three years of naming; firm, he said, is either the one at the far end or the reason you learned to name. He said the naming was never mentioned.

The ⑨ firm I remember is the one named in the plan, which closed in 1967 and is still described as the quietest in the street. A ⑩ firm, my mother said in 1969, is the only one that improves by being named; every firm, she said, is a resolve that has agreed to look like a company. She said the resolve was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 公司；商行（指街上每一家旁边的那一家）
B. n. 公司（指那一家本身，与店铺相对）
C. 固定搭配：set up a firm 开办一家公司
D. n. 公司（指留给孩子们的那一家）
E. n. 公司（抽象总称，指一条街上的立号之事）
F. n. 公司（指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一家）
G. n. 坚定；坚毅（指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）
H. n. 坚定（抽象总称，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西）

items.q: set up a firm that no clerk in the street would have named
The firm, meaning the company itself and not the shop
the firm at the far end
the firm was the whole of the matter
the firm had become a line in a plan
The firm of the whole thing
A firm, my mother said in 1969

answers.why: set up a firm 意为“开办一家公司”，1958 年祖父开办了一家街上没有一位职员肯说出名字的公司。
firm 意为“公司”，指那一家本身而不是店铺，它经过了三年而在簿子上没有被说出名字。
firm 意为“公司”，指街上每一家旁边的那一家，每一家旁边都有同一块短短的招牌。
firm 意为“公司”，指留给孩子们的那一家，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
firm 意为“坚定、坚毅”，指一件事里人人都等却无人说破的那样东西，叔叔说这份坚定就是那件事的全部。
firm 意为“坚定”，指人人都等却无人说破的那样东西而不是那一家公司，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
firm 意为“公司”，指计划里写到、被说出名字的那一家，到 1965 年这一家成了计划里的一行。
firm 意为“公司”，祖父四月写道，整件事的立号之事是一条街道和三年的说出名字。
firm 意为“公司”，我记得的是计划里被说出名字的那一家，1967 年结束了，至今仍被说成街上最安静的一家。
firm 为抽象总称，母亲 1969 年说，一家公司是唯一会因为被好好说出名字而变得更好的东西。
